label: agent
scenario: Dental clinic LLM voice assistant self-identifies as virtual, answers insurance, availability and hours questions in full sentences.
task: Ask Maple Grove Dental whether they accept Delta Dental PPO and take new patients, and get Riverside hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: hi! thanks for calling Maple Grove Dental. I'm Ava, the virtual assistant. I can help with appointments, insurance questions, and office hours. how can I help today?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi Ava, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Brian Castillo. does your office accept Delta Dental PPO, and are you taking new patients?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: great questions. yes, Maple Grove Dental is in network with Delta Dental PPO. and we are currently accepting new patients at both our Elm Street and Riverside locations.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: thank you. what's the soonest new patient exam at the Riverside location?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: the earliest new patient exam at Riverside is currently Tuesday, September twenty second at eight thirty AM. would you like me to help schedule that?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: not right now, Brian wants to check his calendar first. what are the Riverside hours?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Riverside is open Monday through Thursday from eight AM to five PM, and Friday from eight AM to one PM. is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: you're welcome! have a great day, and we hope to see Brian soon.
